**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 10:32
- [FACT] User is planning a trip to Disneyland in California.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The closest airport to Disneyland in California is John Wayne Airport (SNA), which is located approximately 14 miles away.
- [USER] User asked for affordable transportation options from John Wayne Airport to Disneyland.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested affordable transportation options from John Wayne Airport to Disneyland include:
  1. Shuttle services: Prices vary, often around $20-$30 per person.
  2. Public transportation: OCTA bus system costs around $2 per person, trip takes approximately 45 minutes.
  3. Ride-sharing services: Apps like Uber and Lyft cost around $20-$30 for a ride.
  4. Rental cars: Rates start at around $25 per day, parking at Disneyland can be expensive.
- [USER] User inquired about the cheapest shuttle service from John Wayne Airport to Disneyland.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that it does not have access to up-to-date pricing information for shuttle services and mentioned popular affordable shuttle services: Super Shuttle, Disneyland Resort Express, and Karmel Shuttle. Recommended checking their websites for prices and booking in advance.
- [USER] User expressed interest in the public transportation option and asked about the reliability and navigation of the bus system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The OCTA bus system is generally reliable and easy to navigate. Route 76 connects the airport to Disneyland, bus fare is around $2 per person, tickets can be purchased onboard or with an OCTA Wave card. Recommended using Google Maps or Transit app for schedules and planning.
- [USER] User expressed concern about carrying luggage on the bus and asked if there is enough space to store it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] OCTA buses have limited space for luggage. Each passenger can bring one carry-on bag and one personal item. Larger items may need to be stored in a limited designated area in the front of the bus. Suggested considering other transportation options if the user has a lot of luggage.
- [USER] User requested recommendations for affordable hotels near Disneyland.
